title: A sock manufacturing partner from development to packed goods.
intro: Huakui works with brands, promotional merchandise buyers, retailers, sports teams and e-commerce sellers on custom sock programmes. Since 2003, our Foshan, China factory has supported product development, sampling, production, branding details and packaging before bulk production.

capabilities.title: Develop from a reference
capabilities.text: Start from a sock sample, product image or artwork, then turn the direction into a clearer sock specification.

capabilities.title: Sample before bulk
capabilities.text: Use sampling to review size, colour, logo treatment, packaging, hand-feel and wash results before production approval.

capabilities.title: Build the sock and brand details
capabilities.text: Jacquard, knitted logos, embroidery, printing, functional sport-sock development, labels, hangtags, belly bands and retail-ready packaging can be planned together.

capabilities.title: Inspect finished goods
capabilities.text: Huakui carries out finished-product inspection and can cooperate with buyer-arranged inspection requirements.

productionStages.title: Knitting
productionStages.caption: Each order is knitted to the approved construction and specification.
productionStages.alt: Sock knitting machines operating at Huakui factory in Foshan

productionStages.title: FQC Sock Inspection
productionStages.caption: Semi-finished socks receive visual checking during production handling.
productionStages.alt: Factory worker checking a sock beside knitting machines

productionStages.title: Embroidery
productionStages.caption: Computerised embroidery is completed in-house for applicable logo work.
productionStages.alt: Computerised embroidery machines at Huakui sock factory

productionStages.title: Boarding & Shaping
productionStages.caption: Boarding helps stabilise the sock shape and dimensions for a consistent finish.
productionStages.alt: Worker operating sock boarding and shaping equipment

productionStages.title: Pairing & Matching
productionStages.caption: Left and right socks are matched by size, colour and style.
productionStages.alt: White logo socks being paired and matched at Huakui factory

productionStages.title: Packing
productionStages.caption: Finished products are packed to the approved packaging requirements.
productionStages.alt: Worker preparing socks for packing at Huakui factory

productionStages.title: Pre-shipment Inspection
productionStages.caption: Finished goods are checked again before shipment preparation.
productionStages.alt: Factory worker inspecting finished socks before shipment

productionStages.title: Warehousing & Logistics
productionStages.caption: Packed cartons are staged and loaded in line with the order plan.
productionStages.alt: Packed cartons being loaded into a shipping container outside Huakui factory
